claim: Semantic pause intentions authored from the integrated script and the scene source before any narration exists: questions before answers, calculations, new concepts, contrasts, protected phrases, and every picture hold bound to its source event. Ranges are editorial hypotheses for the total quiet heard, not measurements or acceptance. Nothing was synthesized or listened to.

accounting.range_s: Total quiet heard at the boundary: recorded quiet on both sides plus any inserted silence plus scene delay, each counted once (the director's audit sums tail quiet + scene delay + lead quiet across cues).
accounting.inside_a_take: Within one unit's take (inside a cue, or at a contiguous seam, where the kit inserts nothing), pause to add = max(0, range_s[0] - measured quiet at the reviewed boundary), applied as an exact-sample edit before assembly. Never inside a protected_phrase.
accounting.at_a_kit_cue_edge: Between units the kit already gives max(class, tail_A + lead_B + 0.10). To reach T above that, insert X = T - 0.10 - (tail_A + lead_B) at A's end, X >= 0 (narration.rs class_gap; MIN_GAP_S 0.10; inserted cue-end zeros are counted as tail and re-subtracted).
accounting.at_a_visual_hold: Pause to add = 0. The hold is the pause; the audit marks it protected_visual_hold.
accounting.application_limit: These equations are bookkeeping proposals only. Do not auto-insert silence from range minima. Localization, contextual review, intentional holds and measured assembled audio must be qualified before any edit.
